webroot.description: The root directory for the web server when running in server mode.

port.description: The port number for the server in server mode.

max_clients.description: The maximum number of concurrent clients allowed in server mode.

url.description: The target URL to test or benchmark.

request_count.description: The number of requests to send before stopping.

compr.description: Whether to send Accept-Encoding: gzip,deflate in the request.

showhdr.description: Whether to show the HTTP reply header.

dump.description: Whether to show the HTTP reply header and body.

head.description: Whether to use the HEAD method instead of GET.

http10.description: Whether to use HTTP/1.0 instead of HTTP/1.1.

close.description: Whether to close the connection after reading few bytes.

host.description: The hostname to use for the Host: field in the HTTP request.

timesplit.description: Whether to show transfer times for different data chunks.

wait.description: Number of seconds to wait between requests.

clients.description: Number of concurrent clients to spawn.

referer.description: The URL to send as the referer header.

cookies.description: List of cookies to send with the request (name/value pairs). Used as an items schema definition for list elements in this context, though strictly it's a list of objects defined by `items` schema below if using nested structures, but here we use flat list of objects in the schema for the items themselves if needed, however standard list schema doesn't support item objects easily without complex nesting. Per instructions: 'For a list-of-objects, add items as a FLAT map field-name'. So we define the item structure here.
